siteDescription: An editorial guide to the Mornington Peninsula, rebuilt as a sharper cover page with weekly curation, featured stories, venue picks, and a clear newsletter invitation.

hero.dek: Less brochure, more editorial cover. Peninsula Insider should feel like the front page of a publication that already knows where you should book first, where you should linger, and what is actually worth the drive.

featuredStory.dek: The crowds are gone and the Peninsula is showing a different face. Cellar doors with room to breathe, long lunches without a booking queue, and a coastline that finally feels like yours.

weekendPlanner.title: Truffle season opens, a wildlife-reserve market, and the galleries' final weekend
weekendPlanner.dek: Autumn closes and winter opens on the same patch of Main Ridge on Saturday. Opening day of the 2026 truffle season, a free Sunday market in the bush, and three exhibitions in their final weekend.

cards.title: Red Hill Truffles, Opening Day of the 2026 Season
cards.note: First day of the 2026 Périgord black truffle season. Hunt in the morning, then the Red Hill Estate lunch built from what the dogs found. Sessions from 11am, Main Ridge. From $189pp (pizza hunt) / $199pp (estate lunch). Opening weekend fills early.

cards.title: Wild Mushroom Forage and Lunch with The Kitchen
cards.note: Main Ridge runs its last Wild Mushroom Forage of the year at 11am — the same hour truffle season opens nearby. Guided foraging and a cook-up to finish.

cards.title: The Enchanted Market at The Briars
cards.note: A quarterly market most visitors don't know exists, set in The Briars Wildlife Reserve, Mount Martha. Boardwalks, native bush, kangaroos and emus. From 10am, free, walk-in.

cards.title: MPRG and Lander-Se, Final Weekend
cards.note: Three exhibitions close Sunday: New Wave 26 and Michael Vale at MPRG, TRACE Duo at Lander-Se nearby. Dunns Road, Mornington. Free, no booking. After Sunday these shows are gone.
